rule.advice: When encountering a SyntaxError due to a missing closing brace while running tests with the bun test command, the common root cause is a mismatched or missing brace in your code. This often results in unexpected end of file errors during execution. To resolve this, carefully inspect code blocks and ensure every opening brace `{` has a corresponding closing brace `}`. Implementing consistent formatting practices, such as using code linters or IDE features for auto-indentation, can help catch these issues early.
